name: Warm-up
desc: Greeting, identity confirmation and opening question
guidance: Welcome the candidate warmly, confirm their readiness, and ask a gentle introductory technical question.

name: Fundamentals
guidance: Ask fundamental concept questions on the chosen topic, focusing on definitions, standard complexities, and basics.

name: Depth
desc: Probe reasoning, trade-offs and edge cases
guidance: Dive deep into internal mechanisms, memory allocations, concurrency safety, and performance trade-offs.

name: Applied Problem
guidance: Present a realistic system scenario, debugging challenge, or algorithmic problem for the candidate to solve step-by-step.

name: Wrap-up
desc: Final opportunity for the student to add context
guidance: Ask if the candidate has any closing thoughts or additional technical insights to share regarding the topic.

name: Scoring
desc: Evaluate transcript and prepare evidence-linked feedback
guidance: Summarize the interview politely and let the candidate know their comprehensive evaluation is being prepared.
